_comment: Workout from a coach screenshot (column D, rows 30-50). Named 'Oct 15' per user; date 2026-10-15.
'2x200 (50 pat flecha vel - 75L nadando)': partial-distance split stays one 200 step with a note (see CLAUDE.md simplifications). The two 75s do not add to 200 in the source; left as written.
'4x24 contando brazadas' read as 4x25 (24 looks like a typo for the pool length); stroke count is in the note.
'Elegir CI o L': two branches (Combinadistas: 3x (300 CI x75 + 100 suave); Libristas: 4x300 30sp + 100 suave). Only the Libristas branch is built; swap if the CI branch is wanted.
'30sp' = 30 s timed rest after each 300. '100 afloje' = cooldown.
